# Changelog

Generated by `frob release changelog` from `changelog.d/` fragments; compiled at release, never hand-edited.
The history of frob v1 (before 0.532.0) is in [CHANGELOG-v1.md](CHANGELOG-v1.md).

## 0.532.0 - 2026-10-05

frob 0.532.0 is the v2 Rust rewrite and replaces v1 on upgrade. To stay on v1 run uv tool install frob==0.531.0 (or pip install frob==0.531.0); docs/guides/upgrade-from-v1.md lists what changed, maps v1 commands to v2 and explains how far tickets can be imported. (~2FCV344, 01M4069YE7SYCYT7YGT2FCV344)

### frob

#### Added

- Added `frob cycle new`, `show`, `list` and `close`: a cycle is a dated time box (end defaults to start plus `[pm] cycle_days` minus one) that refuses overlap with an open cycle, and `close` carries incomplete tickets to the next cycle with `cycle` events, records the commitment-versus-done ratio and an optional retro note, and refuses while a member is in progress under a live lease. (~K6V6Y0D, 01M4069RPPQE1ES1914K6V6Y0D)
- Added `frob cycle assign TICKET [CYCLE]` and `cycle unassign`: assign defaults to the open cycle holding today (else the next planned), moves a ticket out of its previous open or planned cycle, refuses epics and unestimated tickets, and refuses past capacity (the cycle's `capacity_points`, else rolling mean minus `[pm] capacity_k` times stddev of delivered points once `[pm] min_history` cycles have closed) with exit 3 unless `--over-commit --reason TEXT`, which records an `over-commit` cycle event shown on the cycle report. (~SS2FEHN, 01M4069SHBAEWRX9WWCSS2FEHN)
- frob cycle velocity prints points delivered per closed cycle, the rolling mean and standard deviation, and the capacity cycle assign would use. (~0AN408B, 01M4069SYRHMYXCFAZH0AN408B)
- tickets have a class of service (expedite, fixed-date, standard, intangible; default standard) set with `ticket new --class` and `ticket update --class` and shown in `ticket show` and `ticket list`; `ticket doable` lists expedite first, then fixed-date tickets by due date; `work` and `start` let one expedite ticket (`[pm.classes] expedite_max`) exceed `[pm.wip] in_progress` and refuse a further one with E-WIP-EXPEDITE (exit 3). (~ZQRNCXY, 01M4069VZVMHVZ15RSPZQRNCXY)
- REL003 (changelog fragment required) is now a check rule: `frob check` reports every changelog.d fragment that does not validate (unknown type, bad ULID, ULID with no ticket, empty or non-ASCII body, near-miss product prefix), `frob check --ticket` also reports an open ticket with no fragment and names `frob ticket fragment`, and the changelog_fragment close guard now refuses an invalid fragment with the validation message instead of checking only that a file exists. (~HE2EX99, 01M4069WD4P8ZZ5HGQ5HE2EX99)
- New `frob ticket fragment TICKET` writes the changelog fragment skeleton from the ticket title, and the changelog_fragment refusal on close and land now names it. (~3TXB8SR, 01M4069WHH6KXYWDAJD3TXB8SR)
- `frob release status` (and the `release cut` readiness gate) now reads CI for the base-branch tip through `gh api`: red or still-running checks are blockers naming the failing checks and links, and an unreadable result (no checks, `gh` missing or unauthenticated, no network, non-GitHub origin) is an Unresolved line with the exact reason and remedy that also blocks unless `[release] require_ci = false`; the commit inspected is named, and unknown is never treated as green. (~4PT3KZB, 01M4069WYA9D1EGVEBC4PT3KZB)
- Added an artifact smoke that proves an installed frob works in a real repository: `packaging/smoke/fixture-loop.sh` runs init, ticket, work, check, evidence, changelog fragment and land on a throwaway fixture repository, and every wheel and standalone-archive release job (except the cross-built macOS x86_64 exemption) runs it. (~NWXQPMM, 01M4069XXM8A47Y1F88NWXQPMM)
- Added a release workflow smoke job that installs each target's downloaded wheel and archive on a fresh runner (cross-built macOS x86_64 exempt); every publishing job needs it and a workflow test pins timeouts, SHA pins, tag-only triggers and the exemption list. (~DH63PV1, 01M4069Y1YR0XCN4BKDDH63PV1)
- cargo dev publish publishes the workspace crates to crates.io in dependency order, resumably, and a release job runs it through trusted publishing after the artifact smoke. (~6N2KET1, 01M4069Y65FA7GGXG2F6N2KET1)
- Added docs/guides/release.md, the release runbook: owner setup, environments, per-release steps and how to resume a failed release. (~H7BCMWX, 01M4069YJX5XQPJWAW1H7BCMWX)
- `frob ticket doctor` now also checks milestones and cycles (E-PM-* codes, counts per kind, `--fix` re-folds drifted frontmatter), and `frob init` plus the `merge-driver` verb cover `milestone.md` and `cycle.md`, so a concurrent edit of one milestone on two branches merges without a conflict. (~5Y8JFGW, 01M4095RVEYWMEWQJFT5Y8JFGW)
- Added the `attestation` evidence provider for ticket and milestone criteria that no tool can measure; only a listed `[evidence] attesters` identity at a terminal, with no agent marker, can attest, and every view labels it as an attestation. `milestone criterion remove` now reports the evidence it loses. (~7KQSA8Z, 01M40AKKXBN7K30090V7KQSA8Z)
- ticket close and land accept --no-changelog --reason TEXT to close a change with no user-visible effect without a changelog fragment, recorded as an audited changelog-exempt event that release status lists. (~Y8ZYBDW, 01M412CMSRCHNXHEEENY8ZYBDW)
- Release tags and products are configuration (`[release] tag` and `products`; default one product tagged v{version}), and `release changelog` omits the product heading for one product and adopts a hand-written CHANGELOG.md. (~B5DF7DD, 01M413T4PVDKZ014X3WB5DF7DD)
- check --ticket leads with findings in the ticket's diff and summarises the rest as counts. (~V92VDGB, 01M413V8CDKKBSBV8JDV92VDGB)
- frob release notes --version X prints that version's CHANGELOG section, and the release job now uses it as the GitHub release body. (~DY20758, 01M41B4KPWQVBT234N2DY20758)
- cargo dev publish now waits out crates.io rate limits (or stops resumably with exit 75), cargo dev publish --reserve pre-reserves missing crate names, and the PyPI release job no longer waits for crates.io. (~0JTYGH0, 01M42026M27TR9YV0C60JTYGH0)
- frob now finds sibling binaries such as grimble next to its own executable first, then on PATH, and check (data.siblings) and doctor report which copy was used and any second copy with a different version. (~JS1VMBC, 01M421F7Q66MW38R7J1JS1VMBC)
- Added frob release adopt VERSION, which records hand-made published tags as a release cut (an adopt event after the usual cut event) without touching git or the remote, so REL001 no longer forces deleting a published tag; REL001's remedy now names it first. (~8ANQEZE, 01M4235FC39ZQYF207H8ANQEZE)
- frob land now refuses only findings the ticket introduces: findings already on the base tip are reported as pre-existing instead of blocking, and base findings the ticket fixes are reported as resolved. (~QAFRXM3, 01M4235FSBRRXMX4Q72QAFRXM3)
- Garbage collection is now automatic: a throttled pass in frob work and frob land removes finished worktrees (never ones with unsaved work), stale build incremental state, over-budget build artifacts, old caches and unreferenced evidence blobs under the new [gc] config, and frob doctor reports usage and what a pass would reclaim (frob doctor --fix runs one now). (~BZXZK29, 01M424QEMYGC9VZZYX9BZXZK29)
- Python files (.py, .pyi) are now parsed: frob check reads their comments and directives, builds symbols, imports, calls and tests, and reports constructs it cannot model as Unresolved. (~F0KSGKF, 01M43A5DJT8XBQYEK36F0KSGKF)
- frob test now selects and runs the pytest tests that reach a changed Python function, and ticket evidence add accepts --provider pytest, which records per-test results from pytest's junit report (pytest is allowed by default in [evidence] allowed_tools). (~M525Y1M, 01M43A5MA7GRAACT7E0M525Y1M)
- Added the crunk binary scaffold: crunk check prints an empty gob.sibling/1 document, crunk doctor reports config state, and a missing crunk.toml exits 3 with E-NO-CONFIG. (~FYH8FGQ, 01M43ARVS24254G85TMFYH8FGQ)
- crunk is now a registered release product: it has its own archive and wheel per platform, a preview tag, and an archive smoke, while its PyPI upload stays held back until the Python crunk is retired. (~8CRC1ZH, 01M43ARWCVRCE25KDZC8CRC1ZH)
- crunk.toml now has a documented schema (docs/schemas/crunk.json and docs/crunk/config.md) and a loader that rejects unknown keys with their line and a did-you-mean. (~BWXXV5H, 01M43ARX764095Q4VWABWXXV5H)
- Added ticket triage accept, decline, snooze, duplicate and list: decide inbox tickets singly or by --label query in one ledger commit, with snoozed tickets hidden until their date. (~PM0HX6M, 01M44C546DQRE4D11HHPM0HX6M)
- Release changelog dates and every other date frob writes now come from one UTC clock read once per command, so a release cut just after midnight UTC is dated the same on every machine. (~V8FWY2P, 01M44R5VQ21TNKGEC31V8FWY2P)
- Added C# (.cs) grammar and comment scanning so directives and TODO001 read C# comments and skip every string form. (~N2HND27, 01M44YQSHSC4N13E98FN2HND27)
- C# files now yield symbols: namespaces, types, members and local functions with their attributes, base types and #if conditions, and partial classes merge into one unit with several spans. (~ER9HRA2, 01M44YQSZ3YEXRDW9RKER9HRA2)

#### Changed

- Closing or landing a story, bug or security ticket with no acceptance criteria is now refused (E-DONE-NO-CRITERIA); chore, docs and epic tickets are exempt. (~H1NWDN9, 01M1T07NXZ5WQR200M5H1NWDN9)
- Derived executable state now has an authenticated store outside the work tree: entries carry a MAC, are written atomically, and any tampered or truncated entry is discarded. (~TX6YZZE, 01M3ZX7JACXBTB74QS6TX6YZZE)
- Text output now escapes control, bidi and invisible characters in messages, paths, snippets and fixes as \u{..}, so hostile text cannot repaint the terminal; JSON output keeps strings exact. (~PJH50MJ, 01M3ZX7Z0EM0DCAHC59PJH50MJ)
- frob check now warns when a milestone has no goal or no exit criteria (PM001), and when a milestone has no epics or a member epic is done with open work under it (PM002). (~JWAAVRY, 01M4069REJDB8FFVZFMJWAAVRY)
- `frob cycle plan` proposes a cycle commitment from ready work in rank order, preferring the next milestone and never past capacity; `--apply` assigns it, and PM033 now points at it. (~ZQHJH6H, 01M4069T2V69X32EP8NZQHJH6H)
- PM013 warns, naming the holders, when more tickets are in progress than [pm.wip] in_progress allows. (~ED96MPY, 01M4069TBHQ2YTFEEWHED96MPY)
- a new advisory rule, PM033, tells you when the ready queue (the tickets `frob ticket doable` lists) falls below `[pm] ready_min`. (~TV5ZYFS, 01M4069TJA7YJTYSZCATV5ZYFS)
- add `frob board`, the scrumban board with text columns by category, WIP limits from the shared count, an expedite lane, stale marks and card age. (~4XZVMNC, 01M4069W45P08YPC4YH4XZVMNC)
- the release workflow gains a `pypi` job that uploads the smoked wheels to PyPI through trusted publishing from the protected `pypi` environment, after the crates.io publish. (~DR38G0G, 01M4069YA9PXDNNCV86DR38G0G)
- Add a dev channel: every green land on the base branch rebuilds the archives into the GitHub prerelease dev. (~NE8Z036, 01M4069YQHN3EMTKR3RNE8Z036)
- The release workflow now installs rustup-init (a versioned download checked against its sha256) and maturin (--require-hashes) only from hash-pinned sources, and the no-sdist decision is recorded. (~J84QNJ9, 01M40SF7A9NVCN6HJE4J84QNJ9)
- This repository allows four tickets in progress now that sccache halves worktree build time. (~2J6PM7K, 01M412NNKMX02EQ3EY42J6PM7K)
- The work gate and PM013 now count WIP with one lease-aware, expedite-lane-aware rule. (~7HWFTBP, 01M416Z11V5GR012FR47HWFTBP)
- Publish the full crate set (35 crates, all but gob-dev and gob-mdtest) and let the crates job use a first-publish CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN, falling back to trusted publishing. (~AZS0RRT, 01M4172YE3SZDG17J1CAZS0RRT)
- `frob board --text` now prints its rows raw, with no envelope header, list markers or indent, so the board uses the full terminal width. (~0X2ANR8, 01M41B2P3B5KVG5FJ5B0X2ANR8)
- new `[pm] strict` knob (default false); when true, PM001, PM002, PM013 and PM034 report as errors instead of warnings. (~3750GWB, 01M41B2PD4NAV8VACA13750GWB)
- A fragment named <ulid>.notice.md is a lead notice: release changelog renders it first, above the product and type groups, and refuses a second one in the same section. (~V50ZAVN, 01M41BWB5H544DN5ADDV50ZAVN)
- Link docs/guides/release.md from the registry setup item of frob release status. (~0ZJET37, 01M41EBQN0HT7956KPP0ZJET37)
- ticket fragment now requires --sentence for bug, security and incident tickets, so the changelog line describes the change instead of repeating the problem title. (~9QNMT4D, 01M41JTGCWXZWWSPXYM9QNMT4D)
- PyPI now carries one wheel set per product: grimble installs on its own, and frob's wheel no longer bundles it but depends on grimble at the same version, so pip or uv install frob pulls both and frob finds grimble beside itself. (~TPHS84G, 01M421FB3B2P9EMNKPDTPHS84G)
- cargo dev ci can run its heavy steps on a goway host when CARGO_DEV_CI_REMOTE names the goway binary, and its summary shows the host and separates goway failures from step failures. (~ZWEYXGZ, 01M42A37XTPF2H1WXQQZWEYXGZ)
- Added the crunk-values crate with CSS color and length parsing, WCAG contrast and palette distance. (~NRTJ3KW, 01M43ARVJKKN4EXCQF1NRTJ3KW)

#### Fixed

- Stacked directives above one item now all bind to it: a directive block (consecutive directive lines, optionally interleaved with ordinary comments, doc comments and attributes such as `#[test]`) binds every directive in it to the item below, so several `frob:tests` lines above one test no longer leave the others unbound, and a `frob:tests` directive that attaches to no item (a blank line before the item, or the end of a file) is reported as "directive is not attached to an item" instead of as an unknown symref; a blank line now ends the block (a directive followed by a blank line and an item binds the file or enclosing symbol, no longer the item two lines away). (~8Z6EXFW, 01M40H2JYVEHBZD62WV8Z6EXFW)
- two concurrent `frob work` calls can no longer both take the last repository WIP slot; the count now runs inside the lease-store lock. (~PAZP9JM, 01M40Q3S4T9QTYX0Z1MPAZP9JM)
- `frob init` now writes the ledger merge driver as the running executable's absolute path when `frob` on PATH is a different frob (bare `frob` otherwise), with `--driver-command` and `--fix-driver`, and `frob doctor` reports a driver that resolves to a different frob or to nothing, with the fix command. (~JD0NPX1, 01M40SG11J388ZYWB7YJD0NPX1)
- Closing a cycle before its planned end records the close day as its effective end, which overlap, velocity, capacity, the commitment ratio and carry-over use; `cycle show` and `list` report both ends. (~D5W8ERW, 01M40SMB58CSHSFV8FTD5W8ERW)
- Fixed `frob check --ticket` reporting untouched symlinks as SCOPE001 changes: the worktree side of the branch diff now uses gix status (symlinks compared as links, core.autocrlf and filters applied as git does). (~NTKAXC1, 01M40T3VA5Y86ZQH234NTKAXC1)
- PROC001 is now a repository-local policy: it is inert unless `[check] process_spawners` lists crates, and it matches spawning APIs only (`Command`, `Child`, `Stdio`, exec/spawn), never `ExitCode`, `exit`, `abort` or `id`. (~XGS6PK2, 01M40T3VS6VVN80SP39XGS6PK2)
- Fixed `frob ack` leaving `frob.lock` (and `grimble.lock`) reported by SCOPE001 as outside the ticket lease: both lock files are bookkeeping written by frob's own verbs and are now exempt, like the ledger directory. (~FJT8C2Q, 01M40T3WSDHBQ71K2F2FJT8C2Q)
- Digests and parsed text now follow git's clean conversion, so a core.autocrlf checkout with no content change no longer raises EXC005 or DRIFT001, symlinks hash as their target, and the ledger's local-edit check shares the same helper. (~M4T7MXR, 01M40THSWB75TFY8949M4T7MXR)
- `frob cycle close CYCLE --next-goal TEXT [--next-days N]` creates the next cycle the day after the effective end and carries unfinished members into it in one operation (E-CYCLE-NO-NEXT names the flag), and a closed cycle no longer blocks `cycle new` on the same dates: the new cycle's alias gets a numeric suffix (`START..END.2`). (~NNNA877, 01M40VQWCV38B2JCABYNNNA877)
- `ticket close` and `land` now enforce every entry of `[pm] done_requires`: `criteria_evidenced` (every acceptance criterion bound; `--no-evidence --reason` stays the audited bypass for it alone), `no_open_children`, and `changelog_fragment` (a `changelog.d/<ULID>.<type>.md` must exist). `docs_touched_or_excepted` and quality-objective `objective_target_met` refuse as Unresolved because they cannot be evaluated yet. The running `frob` and its `grimble` sibling are allowed command-evidence tools without listing them in `[evidence] allowed_tools`. (~XGAS05X, 01M40WS6200M99J09D5XGAS05X)
- Every remedy now names a command that exists, checked by a test against the CLI registry. (~992AN0Q, 01M40YQZF4422S88TN6992AN0Q)
- A ticket's own changelog fragment is always in scope for SCOPE001 and never contends for a lease, and lease widen refuses changelog.d/** globs that would block other tickets (~YP2Y2R3, 01M410A4XR556D484CYYP2Y2R3)
- Evidence records now keep ledger files ASCII: nextest runs with plain output, and any remaining non-ASCII tool output is escaped as `\u{...}` before it is written. (~G31XEZ3, 01M413T4GRZDC843XFPG31XEZ3)
- A cycle whose start date has come is now active instead of staying planned; cycle state is derived from the UTC date and the close. (~0MQNY3G, 01M413V82EXMRXXVWZN0MQNY3G)
- land --wait now retries a stale base itself (re-merging, re-checking only when code changed, with jittered backoff) and reports attempts. (~VMHTBE7, 01M415AC5KGV3FMV512VMHTBE7)
- Attestation statements and facts with non-ASCII characters are now refused at input with a usage error naming the first character and its escape. (~G39YHBW, 01M415HTAQ7YSKXW09DG39YHBW)
- A frob:accept in a YAML comment now suppresses the finding on the key below it, so a workflow no longer needs an inline zizmor ignore. (~2PM2R2K, 01M418CXCED7DEBX4WV2PM2R2K)
- Lockfiles no longer serialize parallel tickets: [lease] shared_files defaults to the well-known lockfiles, the E-LEASE-HELD remedy names it, and land regenerates a conflicted Cargo.lock offline. (~CTKE1J4, 01M418TM2GZ24YPQE7ECTKE1J4)
- frob check now evaluates PM001, PM002 and PM034 when the ledger holds milestones but no tickets. (~WETTCK4, 01M41DQF8CJG567CJ1AWETTCK4)
- Lease overlap no longer treats two wildcard globs with a shared literal prefix as overlapping; it compares them segment by segment, so crates/*/Cargo.toml and crates/frob-evidence/tests/** are disjoint. (~8C6Y5DZ, 01M41FDWMMZTSHZETC48C6Y5DZ)
- ticket doctor no longer reports E-PM-CONFLICT for early-closed cycles or E-PM-ALIAS for cycles recreated on the same dates: the alias suffix is now stored at creation, and ticket doctor --fix numbers existing duplicates in creation order. (~RFBAJ8P, 01M41KS5P8EGFFGBQSMRFBAJ8P)
- Closing a ticket as invalid, duplicate or wont-fix now needs only --reason: no measured evidence, criteria or changelog fragment is demanded, while done and fixed keep every guard. (~8RZK7QV, 01M41KT4RMYMMP9SSFN8RZK7QV)
- Test-only: the suite no longer depends on the host git identity and the nul.grmb corpus fixture was renamed to nul-byte.grmb so the repository checks out on Windows. (~M4WWW00, 01M41MWVAZM5SVK5A91M4WWW00)
- CI no longer fetches a nonexistent actionlint-py version, and the workspace is clippy-clean for Windows targets. (~RBF6057, 01M41PEAN0RE8DBEKQ1RBF6057)
- On Windows, the ledger merge driver that frob init writes now runs under git for Windows, and the command-tool allowlist, trust key directory and worktree cleanup no longer trip over backslash paths. (~G5RJY40, 01M41RK1G648EJJNRK4G5RJY40)
- The ledger scrub and TICK004 now share one style-aware path matcher, so a Unix or Windows home path or sibling worktree path in a ledger is scrubbed to the same placeholders on any host. (~SKCPWMA, 01M41VT71KGG1AXT491SKCPWMA)
- A warm frob check no longer rescans every file for directives: scan results are cached by content digest, so an unchanged repository skips that stage almost entirely. (~A8AMNGF, 01M41ZSWGC86TY3K0NSA8AMNGF)
- The dev and release builds now ship exactly one archive per product, frob-cli-<target> (holding frob) and grimble-<target> (holding grimble), instead of also archiving a test helper. (~24K7SMT, 01M422D5YRH5TG4499Z24K7SMT)
- the check cache is now one SQLite file per repository under the git common dir, shared by the primary checkout, every ticket worktree and land's base checkout, and land keeps the per-base finding set there too, so a land no longer re-checks unchanged files from cold and a second ticket on the same base runs no base check. (~TSK0M4Y, 01M42B6T28RX9PVM3X6TSK0M4Y)
- Opening a fresh shared cache from two processes at once no longer yields a null cache or loses cache writes. (~CE69AVN, 01M42G1XH9FARCHDA7KCE69AVN)
- ticket close --outcome done now refuses while the ticket branch holds commits not merged into the base (E-DONE-UNMERGED), unless --no-land --reason is given and audited, and ticket doctor reports such tickets as E-DOCTOR-UNMERGED. (~CKZS2R3, 01M42M1KBKRWKN4D3A1CKZS2R3)
- frob check now reports every tracked file it cannot read (non-UTF-8 content, permission errors, files over size_cap) as a required READ001 Unresolved finding and counts them under fidelity.skipped, instead of silently dropping them. (~KAD47SZ, 01M42M1KK02KFZG39CXKAD47SZ)
- A ticket field containing a line equal to the +++ fence no longer corrupts ticket.md, and ticket doctor --fix re-renders an unreadable ticket.md from its events. (~SDX5V8M, 01M42MGN2BQNKR7AN7QSDX5V8M)
- ticket close and ticket drop now release the ticket's lease, and ticket doctor reports (and --fix removes) leases left on done tickets. (~0V1WTNR, 01M42MGN8882Y65TVXH0V1WTNR)
- frob check now reports a required Unresolved finding for every rule it could not evaluate (for example with an unreadable ticket ledger) and fails the gate, instead of passing clean. (~A6C2R1C, 01M42MGNE7XHTT1MR5CA6C2R1C)
- Concurrent ticket writes no longer fail with E-LEDGER-CAS: lost ledger compare-and-swap retries now back off with jitter. (~X4HH43T, 01M42MGNM3BBXJ5G2TVX4HH43T)
- Closing a ticket that is still blocked by an open ticket is now refused, and the refusal names the blockers. (~G7AXHR1, 01M42MGNSY7N4NANEFNG7AXHR1)
- A ledger commit from a linked worktree no longer leaves new ticket events staged-deleted in a checkout whose local edits blocked the sync; only the blocked paths are left stale and reported. (~BDHEZAT, 01M42MGNZZ1BY6YCG49BDHEZAT)
- A corrupt lease file no longer blocks lease list or frob work: it is skipped, reported as a warning with a remedy, and kept on disk. (~M0388X5, 01M42MGP62EPY4K7C29M0388X5)
- frob check --fix now refuses files edited since the check (E-FIX-STALE), writes atomically, skips fixes with out-of-range edits and rolls back fixes that leave a file unparsable. (~WS4WZBD, 01M42MGPHZVTJWJHEGJWS4WZBD)
- The state store now retries reads that hit a Windows replace window (PermissionDenied or sharing violation) with a short bounded backoff and reports a miss instead of an error. (~YV9D5RT, 01M42SQ7RJ5T8SJWKRHYV9D5RT)
- land now refuses with E-LAND-CONFLICT, naming the conflicted paths and leaving the worktree untouched, when the refresh merge conflicts in frob.toml, instead of failing with E-CONFIG mid-merge (~66MMPM1, 01M43FX5KWVP277RX5666MMPM1)
- Directive-like text quoted inside multi-line TOML or YAML strings is no longer read as a comment, so imported ticket text no longer triggers DRIFT002, TEST001 or TODO001 errors. (~41MBK6Q, 01M43HGBQ9YS0Z8YPKQ41MBK6Q)
- A file that changed between frob check and frob check --fix is now refused as E-FIX-STALE with exit 3 and a remedy to rerun check, instead of an internal error (exit 4). (~EG4H5JK, 01M43JF3959YKJ4HCNNEG4H5JK)
- frob check no longer reads text quoted in the ticket ledger, or YAML and TOML front matter in markdown files, as directives or work markers, so imported tickets stop raising DSL001 and TODO001. (~JTV288R, 01M43KP0RXKB1DJA8KGJTV288R)
- pytest evidence on Windows now records portable node ids (tests/test_m.py::TestC::test_m) with their class segments. (~VTN9C8B, 01M44J072TEWFTCB1AFVTN9C8B)
- Cycle dates and states are now judged by the UTC day everywhere, so cycle commands no longer change behaviour around midnight UTC in a local zone that is still on the previous day. (~AAZFNR5, 01M44P4SY2DK41TS91PAAZFNR5)
- frob on Windows now finds grimble and crunk installed by uv tool install or pipx, which copy frob.exe into a bin directory instead of linking it, by looking in the tool environment under UV_TOOL_DIR, uv's default tool directory or pipx's venvs directory. (~HA1TTRM, 01M452Q6THBSZGVHRAYHA1TTRM)

#### Security

- Ledger events no longer carry absolute local paths: lease reasons record the worktree relative to the repository parent, captured evidence text has the worktree, repository and home directory rewritten to placeholders before it is hashed and stored, and the new TICK004 rule warns about committed ledger files that still hold a home path. (~33PZ67A, 01M41PM9TCJ8MJQREJ733PZ67A)
- TICK004 (an absolute home path in a committed ledger file) is now an error, and ticket doctor --fix scrubs those paths out of an existing ledger in one forward commit, recomputing evidence digests and recording an audit scrub event per ticket, without rewriting git history. (~6JTAH9Q, 01M41RHBJ03PGD6JY0J6JTAH9Q)
- Private names listed in local privacy.toml files are refused in ticket text, flagged by check rule TICK005 and replaced by ticket doctor --fix, without ever being echoed or committed. (~2GXRW72, 01M42EZ8J63P84XFKTR2GXRW72)
- the garbage collector now refuses any path with a . or .. component in every path style before deleting, strips the Windows \\?\ prefix from every canonical path so git calls work, and its automatic pass only reports (deletes nothing) on Windows until windows-latest CI confirms the fix. (~EDPHHFS, 01M42FN1YDHJNZ5NM7QEDPHHFS)

### grimble (preview)

#### Fixed

- SYS001 no longer reports the ticket ledger, changelog.d fragments, frob.lock or .frob/ as unowned files. (~C06R6B7, 01M41H9Y7TTWDN6DAQ5C06R6B7)
